description: Update the adjacent wiki repo to document the new two-level tenant+profile configuration format, the user-scoped token model, the new configure commands (set-tenant, set-profile, export), and the deprecation of 'configure set' and 'tokens export'. The wiki is a SEPARATE git repo at /home/alexiswl/GitHub/UMCCR/icav2-cli-plugins.wiki (branch master, remote umccr/icav2-cli-plugins.wiki) — edit and commit on master, do NOT create a worktree for it. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being implemented so the documented behavior matches the code.
steps: In /home/alexiswl/GitHub/UMCCR/icav2-cli-plugins.wiki run `grep -rilE "configure set|tokens export|tenant|x_api_key|server_url|\\.icav2-cli-plugins/config" . --include="*.md"` to find every page that references the old config or commands (known: Configuration.md, Home.md, Installation.md, commands/ContextHandling.md, stories/creating-bundles-in-icav2.md, stories/pipeline-deployments-via-github.md).

Rewrite Configuration.md (primary) to describe the two-level layout: a [tenant <name>] section holding server_url, x_api_key (encrypted), encryption_public_key, encryption_private_key, access_token (encrypted) and access_token_expiry; and a [profile <name>]/[default] section holding project_id, project_name, tenant_name (pointer to a tenant) and output_format. Explain the user-scoped token model (one token per tenant, shared across that tenant's projects, cached on the tenant). Show an example config with one tenant and two profiles. Document the setup flow: `icav2 configure set-tenant` then `icav2 configure set-profile`, and `icav2 configure export <profile>` with its four export lines (ICAV2_SERVER_URL, ICAV2_BASE_URL=https://<server-url>/ica/rest, ICAV2_PROJECT_ID, ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN). State that `configure set` and `tokens export` are deprecated and name their replacements.

Update Installation.md, Home.md, commands/ContextHandling.md and the stories/ pages where they reference `configure set`, `tokens export`, tenant/profile setup, or the old self-contained config, so examples use set-tenant/set-profile/export and the new format. Update _Sidebar.md only if a page is added/renamed (likely no change).

Commit the changes on the wiki's master branch with a descriptive message (e.g. 'docs: document two-level tenant+profile config, set-tenant/set-profile/export, deprecate configure set & tokens export'). Do not push.
acceptance_criteria: Configuration.md documents the [tenant <name>] and [profile <name>] sections with their exact keys, the user-scoped token model, and an example config.
The set-tenant, set-profile, and export commands are documented, including the four export lines and the base_url derivation https://<server-url>/ica/rest.
The deprecation of `configure set` and `tokens export` (with replacements) is stated in the wiki.
All wiki pages that previously referenced the old commands/config are updated; a commit exists on the wiki master branch.
verification: git -C /home/alexiswl/GitHub/UMCCR/icav2-cli-plugins.wiki diff --stat (before commit) shows the edited pages
grep -rl "set-tenant" /home/alexiswl/GitHub/UMCCR/icav2-cli-plugins.wiki --include="*.md" returns Configuration.md (and any other updated pages)
git -C /home/alexiswl/GitHub/UMCCR/icav2-cli-plugins.wiki log --oneline -1 shows the new docs commit on master
grep -rilE "configure set[^-]|tokens export" /home/alexiswl/GitHub/UMCCR/icav2-cli-plugins.wiki --include="*.md" — any remaining hits are intentional (deprecation notices), not stale instructions
findings: Rewrote Configuration.md as the primary reference for the two-level model: a [tenant <name>] section (server_url, x_api_key encrypted, encryption_public_key, encryption_private_key, access_token encrypted, access_token_expiry) and a [profile <name>]/[default] section (tenant_name pointer, project_id, project_name, output_format), with an example config of one tenant + two profiles sharing credentials. Documented the user-scoped token model (one token per tenant, shared across that tenant's projects, cached on the tenant), the setup flow (configure generate-keys -> set-tenant -> set-profile), and `icav2 configure export <profile>` emitting ICAV2_SERVER_URL, ICAV2_BASE_URL=https://<server-url>/ica/rest, ICAV2_PROJECT_ID, ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN. Added a Deprecated commands table: `configure set` -> set-tenant + set-profile, `tokens export` -> `configure export <profile>` (both still run with a warning). Updated commands/ContextHandling.md, Home.md, Installation.md and stories/pipeline-deployments-via-github.md to use set-tenant/set-profile/export and the new format; adjusted the Configuration link label in Home.md and _Sidebar.md. Verification: `git -C ...wiki diff --stat` showed the edited pages; `grep -rl set-tenant` returns Configuration.md, Home.md, Installation.md, commands/ContextHandling.md, stories/pipeline-deployments-via-github.md; the only remaining `configure set`/`tokens export` hits are the intentional deprecation table in Configuration.md (lines 288-289); commit f449924 exists on wiki master. No code/pytest run was needed (docs-only feature; the test suite is out of scope for FEAT-003). stories/creating-bundles-in-icav2.md's 'tenant' references are conceptual ICAv2 tenant wording, not config, so no change was required. Note: commands/ProjectData.md, commands/ProjectPipelines.md and stories/creating-bundles-in-icav2.md had pre-existing, unrelated working-tree edits in the wiki repo that were left unstaged and NOT committed as part of this feature.
